Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly stated that George Sherman died on "March 15, 2011". The WebSurfer had previously and correctly extracted the death date as "March 15, 1991" from multiple credible sources (Wikipedia, Find a Grave, IMDb). The Planner failed to verify this data, hallucinating a death year of 2011 instead of 1991. While both directors died in the early 2010s in this hallucination (2010 vs 2011), the actual death years are 2010 (Ranga) and 1991 (Sherman). Although the conclusion (Vasantha Sena's director died first) remains numerically correct in this specific instance due to the 2010 vs 2011 comparison, the factual error regarding George Sherman's death year is a critical failure in data verification.
